title: Protocol for the in vitro isolation and culture of mature adipocytes and white adipose tissue explants from humans and mice
protocol: With sterile scissors, dissect the adipose tissue into small, uniformly sized pieces of approximately 40 mg each.
Gently place two pre-cut adipose tissue pieces into each well of a 24-well plate containing 350 μl of DMEM/F12 medium supplemented with 0.2% BSA.
Ensure that the explants are fully immersed in the medium.
Place the culture dishes with the adipose tissue explants in a cell culture incubator set to 37°C and 5% CO2 for 1-2 h.
Check the culture under a microscope to assess the integrity of the adipose tissue explants.
Incubate adipose tissue explants in an incubator under controlled conditions.
Collect conditioned medium from the adipose tissue explants for further analysis.
Alternatively, collect the adipose tissue itself for additional studies such as RNA expression or Western Blot analyses.
Weigh each adipose tissue sample separately.
Place the excised tissue in a sterile petri dish with PBS containing 1% antibiotic/antimycotic solution.
Cut the adipose tissue into small pieces using sterile scissors and forceps.
Transfer the minced tissue to a new sterile petri dish containing PBS.
Repeat washing step twice for a total of three consecutive washes.
Adjust the collagenase concentration based on the tissue weight.
For 2 g of collected WAT adipose tissue, use 10 mL of PBS containing 1% BSA and 0.2% collagenase.
Transfer minced tissue into a sterile 50 mL Falcon tube containing the collagenase solution.
Incubate the tube for 30 min–1 h at 37°C on an orbital shaker set at 200 rpm.
Centrifuge the digested samples at 300 g for 5 min at 22°C.
Invert the tube to facilitate thorough phase mixing.
Repeat the centrifugation step under the same conditions.
Collect the mature adipocytes from the top portion of the centrifuge tube.
Carefully transfer the collected mature adipocytes into a new 15 mL Falcon tube using a Pasteur pipette.
Rinse mature adipocytes with 8–9 mL of PBS to remove impurities or residual solutions.
Centrifuge the Falcon tube containing PBS and adipocytes at 300 g for 5 min at 22°C.
Collect the mature adipocytes from the upper layer using a pipette for subsequent analysis or culture.
Seed the appropriate quantity of mature adipocytes in culture dishes or plates.
Supplement culture medium with DMEM/F12, 10% FBS, and 1% antibiotic/antimycotic solution.
Thoroughly homogenize mature adipocytes with the culture medium before seeding.
Place adipocytes isolated from 1 g of tissue into each well of a 12-well plate.
Maintain adipocytes in a cell culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 18 hours.
Collect mature adipocytes along with the culture medium.
Centrifuge collected mixture at 400 g for 5 minutes at 22°C.
Carefully collect floating adipocytes after centrifugation.
Rinse collected adipocytes with PBS.
Repeat centrifugation of rinsed adipocytes at 400 g for 5 minutes at 22°C.
Recover mature adipocytes from the uppermost layer using a micropipette.
Perform subsequent analysis or freeze adipocytes at -80°C in an Eppendorf for preservation.
Use mature adipocytes within 48 hours post-isolation to ensure optimal functionality and responsiveness of the cells.
